newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Food poisoning kills 13 in Bangladesh, 500 ill.
newsitem.headline: Food poisoning kills 13 in Bangladesh, 500 ill.

text.p: Thirteen people died and at least 500 others fell ill after they took prasad (cooked food) at a Hindu religious festival in the northern Bangladesh district of Mymensingh, police said on Friday.
Hospital doctors told police the illness was caused by food poisoning and the death toll might rise as many victims were battling for their lives.
The incident occurred at Tamait village in Bhaluka district, police told reporters without giving further details.
